title: Subarray Bitwise AND Closest to Target
description: Given an array `nums` of non-negative integers and a non-negative integer `target`, choose any non-empty contiguous subarray `nums[l..r]` (`0 <= l <= r < nums.length`) to minimize `|(nums[l] & nums[l + 1] & ... & nums[r]) - target|`. Return this minimum absolute difference.
hints: As a subarray extends leftward from a fixed right index `r`, its bitwise AND can only clear `1` bits to `0`, so there are at most `31` distinct bitwise AND values ending at `r`.
Maintain the small set of distinct suffix AND values ending at `r - 1`, intersect each with `nums[r]` (plus `nums[r]` itself), and update the best distance to `target`.

examples.explanation: Subarrays [3, 7] (AND = 3) and [7, 15] (AND = 7) are both at distance 2 from target 5.
Every subarray has bitwise AND 1000000, giving |1000000 - 1| = 999999.
Subarray [1, 2] has bitwise AND 1 & 2 = 0, matching target 0 with difference 0.
